name: HDR-Plenoxels
aliases: HDR radiance fields modeled by Plenoxels
definition: A voxel-based volume rendering pipeline that reconstructs 3D HDR radiance fields from multi-view LDR images with varying camera settings, using a coarse-to-fine training scheme and spherical harmonics for view-dependent color representation.
summary: HDR-Plenoxels is a fast, voxel-based method that reconstructs HDR radiance fields from LDR images using explicit sparse grids and differentiable tone mapping, outperforming NeRF in speed.
